story: Supply per head is uneven across the UK. Northern Ireland leads at 6.52 courts per 100,000 people, while Scotland is on 2.06 and London on 3.8.
hold_back: Use the free map for every open court and a free preview of the planning pipeline and catchment analysis across England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland.
why_it_works: It merges the regional imbalance into one clean ranking with named places and the same unit, then points readers to the map and preview layers to inspect local context.
improve: It would be better with a verified atom for a saved regional view or named catchment example inside the product, so the hold-back could be more specific than the general preview.

story: Sheffield is not waiting around. It already has 51 open courts and also approved 10 new schemes in the last year, while East Riding of Yorkshire led approvals with 12.
hold_back: Use the free map for every open court, then the planning-pipeline preview and paid planning details to inspect local schemes and catchments.
why_it_works: It pairs a named place with a hero number and a second named benchmark, showing where open supply and planning momentum are already tangible.
improve: It would improve with a verified atom for a named Sheffield or East Riding planning record set in Padel Genie, so the hold-back could point to a concrete application list rather than general planning details.
